verdict_reason: The split into one-claim contract tests and the new roles, minItems and required-property locks are sound, but one title over-claims a read, one assertion names the non-existent addressType, and the array-to-enum unwrap is written twice.

todos.issue: createAndReadEmitCamelCasePropertiesAndADerivedDeletedBoolean claims create AND read, but the body only POSTs (postAddress, line 28) and asserts on the create response; no GET is made, so a read that emitted snake_case or a status enum would pass.
todos.fix: Must: the title names only what is asserted, or the test asserts the read as well. One way: rename to createEmitsCamelCasePropertiesAndADerivedDeletedBoolean, or add a GET of the created id with the same jsonPath assertions in a second test.

todos.issue: liveAddressRequestHasTheLockedRequiredProperties asserts doesNotContain("addressType") on the locked contract (line 188), naming a property that exists nowhere in the API: an absence check for a rejected or earlier design, beside the exact positive comparison on lines 189-191 that already pins the required set.
todos.fix: Must: the test proves the required set with exact positive assertions only, with no name of a property the API does not have. One way: replace line 188 with assertThat(lockedRequired).contains("roles") (or containsExactlyInAnyOrder of the full locked set) and drop doesNotContain("addressType").

todos.issue: The rule 'an array schema's allowed values sit on its items schema' is written twice in new helpers: listParameterAllowedValues (lines 217-222) and allowedValues (lines 232-236) each test "array".equals(type), unwrap items and read enum.
todos.fix: Must: one helper turns a parameter or property schema into its allowed values, and both callers use it. One way: extract private static List<Object> enumOf(Map<String, Object> schema) holding the array unwrap and the enum read, and call it from listParameterAllowedValues and allowedValues (or move it to ApiDocs beside requiredProperties).
